scenes.title: Scene 1: Morning in the Meadow
scenes.caption: Cow and Horse discover a big woven basket of red apples beside the barn fence!

scenes.title: Scene 2: Helping Along the Trail
scenes.caption: Fluffy Sheep and playful Goat help carry the apple basket down the farm lane!

scenes.title: Scene 3: The Barnyard Pond Picnic
scenes.caption: Pig and Duck join Cow and Sheep for a happy apple picnic by the pond!
